name: Morning Market Breakfast
effect: Line up 3 daytime FOOD vendors (drinks don't count). A dawn tour of the island waking up eating — soy milk, egg crepe, congee.
art_note: Boarding-pass ticket: sunrise over a market arcade, three little breakfast bowls stamped in a row.

name: Dragon-Boat Food Run
effect: Line up 3 FOOD vendors (any phase, drinks don't count). The Dragon-Boat outing — zongzi by the river, boat races at the wharf. (Secular: races + food, no rites.)
art_note: Ticket: a dragon-boat prow on a river, three festival food parcels along the bank.

name: HSR Three-City Hop
effect: Win vendors in 3 DIFFERENT regions. Ride the High Speed Rail and grab a bite in three regions before dusk.
art_note: Ticket: a bullet-train nose over three regional stamps across a map strip.

name: Full-Day Itinerary
effect: Win 4 vendors in total by dusk. Pack the day — a proper island day-trip.
art_note: Ticket: four little stall stamps laid out on a day-planner grid.

name: Beat the Crowds
effect: Win 3 vendors BEFORE dusk. Get in before the queues form and the street turns over.
art_note: Ticket: a wide-awake owl over a sunrise market, a short queue just starting to form.

name: Coin-Snack Tour
effect: Win 3 vendors each costing 2 ingredients or fewer. The beloved 銅板美食 budget crawl — big flavour, small change.
art_note: Ticket: three little coins beside a paper snack tray and a receipt.

name: Budget Bites
effect: Win 2 vendors each costing 2 ingredients or fewer. Small wallet, big appetite.
art_note: Ticket: two coins and a small snack in a paper sleeve.

name: Concert Hall & Dadaocheng
effect: Win 2 North vendors. A Taipei morning: the National Theater & Concert Hall, then breakfast on Dihua Street and tea at the wharf.
art_note: Ticket: the twin swoop-roofs of the National Theater & Concert Hall beside a red-brick Dihua shophouse arcade. (Consultant note: avoid Liberty Square / CKS framing.)

name: Tainan Old-Capital Walk
effect: Win 2 South vendors. Two stops in the old capital — Anping forts and the 國華街 alleys.
art_note: Ticket stamped SOUTH: an Anping fort silhouette over a Tainan oyster-flat motif.

name: Taichung City & Tea
effect: Win 2 Central vendors. Old-town Taichung and the tea belt that gave the world bubble tea.
art_note: Ticket stamped CENTRAL: a Taichung station clock-tower over rolling tea terraces.

name: Taroko Day Trip
effect: Win 1 East vendor. Ride out east — the marble gorge and the coast road.
art_note: Ticket stamped EAST: Taroko gorge cliffs over a rice-terrace coastline.

name: Become a Regular
effect: Win 2 vendors in ONE region (any region). Settle in — get to know a place.
art_note: Ticket: two stamps stacked under one region badge.

name: Taipei–Taichung Line
effect: Win 1 North vendor AND 1 Central vendor. Link the capital and the Central belt — a pork bun and a cup of tea.
art_note: Ticket: a pork bun and a tea leaf stamped together, a rail line running between them.

name: South-Link Coast Run
effect: Win 1 South vendor AND 1 East vendor. The 南迴 southern-link route — prawns of the coast, rice of the hills.
art_note: Ticket: a prawn and a rice ear stamped together over a winding coast road.

name: Hand-Shaken Run
effect: Win 2 drink vendors. The 手搖 tea run every afternoon deserves.
art_note: Ticket: two sweating cups of iced hand-shaken tea.

name: A Bite & a Sip
effect: Win 1 food vendor AND 1 drink. A little of both.
art_note: Ticket: a bowl and a cup side by side.

name: The Breakfast Set
effect: Win 1 daytime food AND 1 drink. The classic morning set — a bite and a cup.
art_note: Ticket: a breakfast bowl and a morning cup.

name: Check-in Trail
effect: Your daytime vendors total at least 8 Draw (人氣). The daytime spots worth queueing for — and posting.
art_note: Ticket: a phone framing a bowl over a rising daytime crowd.

name: Out-Hype the Rival
effect: Win 1 CONTESTED vendor (your rival had Followers on it when you won). Muscle into the hot stall.
art_note: Ticket: two hands reaching for one glowing stall.

name: Round-Island Rail
effect: Win vendors in 3 DIFFERENT regions. Three regions in a day by 臺鐵 rail — the island opening up, stop by stop.
art_note: Ticket: a local rail line looping past three regional stamps.

name: Mid-Autumn BBQ
effect: Win 3 night-market FOOD vendors. The Mid-Autumn cook-out — the whole island fires up the grill. (Secular: BBQ + mooncakes + pomelo, no rites.)
art_note: Ticket: a night grill glowing under a full moon, a pomelo beside it.

name: Neon Bites
effect: Win 2 night-market FOOD vendors. Two stalls under the neon.
art_note: Ticket: two glowing night stalls.

name: Big Eater's Feast
effect: Win 5 FOOD vendors in total (drinks don't count). The Big Eater's grand crawl.
art_note: Ticket: a towering stack of five bowls.

name: Four-Stop Night Run
effect: Win 4 vendors in total. A busy night crossing the market.
art_note: Ticket: four stall stamps in a row.

name: The Grand Tour
effect: Win 6 vendors in total. The full album — the grand tour of the island's tables.
art_note: Ticket: a bulging stamp album.

name: Round-Taiwan · Cycling Route No.1
effect: Win a vendor in ALL 4 regions. The full 環島 lap on Cycling Route No.1 — eat your way around the whole coast.
art_note: Ticket: a bicycle over four regional stamps forming a ring around the island.

name: Chasing a Star
effect: Win a ★ apex vendor. A region's top table — a Michelin / 必比登 name.
art_note: Ticket: a hand plucking a gold star from a marquee sign.

name: Marquee Splurge
effect: Win a vendor costing 3 or more ingredients. Splash out at a 名店 marquee.
art_note: Ticket: a fat wallet snapping open over a feast.

name: Two-Marquee Feast
effect: Win 2 vendors each costing 3 or more ingredients. A big-name double bill.
art_note: Ticket: two heavy coin purses on a night stall.

name: Top of the Charts
effect: Your vendors total at least 14 Draw (人氣). The most-hyped, most-posted stalls on the island — go tall.
art_note: Ticket: a towering crowd and raised phones behind a headline stall.

name: Hualien–Taitung Line
effect: Win 2 East vendors. Two stops down the 花東 rift-valley line — Taroko to the roselle coast.
art_note: Ticket stamped EAST twice over a stone-slab grill and a gorge road.

name: True Local
effect: Win 3 vendors in ONE region (any region). A true local fixture.
art_note: Ticket: three stamps stacked under one region badge.

name: Surf & Turf
effect: Win 1 South vendor AND 1 North vendor. The seafood coast meets the capital's grill.
art_note: Ticket: a prawn and a pork bun stamped together.

name: Taroko–Taipei
effect: Win 1 East vendor AND 1 North vendor. Mountain rice meets the capital.
art_note: Ticket: a rice ear and a pork bun stamped together.

name: Taichung–Kaohsiung
effect: Win 1 Central vendor AND 1 South vendor. Tea belt to harbour city.
art_note: Ticket: a tea leaf and a prawn stamped together.

name: Border Dish
effect: Win 1 cross-region (→X) dish — a night dish whose recipe spans two regions.
art_note: Ticket: a dish straddling two region stamps.

name: Two Borders
effect: Win 2 cross-region (→X) dishes. Flavours from across the island.
art_note: Ticket: two dishes each straddling two regions.

name: Queue-for-it
effect: Win 2 CONTESTED vendors (rival had Followers on them). Beat the rival to the viral queue stalls.
art_note: Ticket: a roaring queue behind a winning agent.

name: Closing-Time Sprint
effect: Win 2 vendors in the FINAL round. Sprint before the shutters roll down.
art_note: Ticket: a departures board flipping to LAST TRAIN.

name: One More Round
effect: Win 3 drink vendors in total. 續攤 — keep the night moving, end on something sweet.
art_note: Ticket: three dessert-and-drink cups in a row.

name: Dawn-to-Dusk Full Day
effect: Win one daytime food, one night-market food, and one drink — one of each venue. The whole day on a plate.
art_note: Ticket: a breakfast bowl, a lantern-lit night stall, and a cup in a triptych.

name: Lantern-Festival Circuit
effect: Win vendors in 3 DIFFERENT regions. A lantern night — the 元宵 Lantern Festival glowing city to city (Pingxi sky-lanterns, secular lights + food).
art_note: Ticket: lantern-lit stalls strung across a night map, sky-lanterns rising.

name: New-Year Market Haul
effect: Win 5 vendors in total. Stocked up for Lunar New Year — the 年貨大街 shopping street at Dihua, arms full.
art_note: Ticket: a red-lantern New-Year market street, dried-goods stalls, five parcels.

name: Money No Object
effect: Your vendors total at least 12 Draw (人氣). Spare no expense — chase the headline names.
art_note: Ticket: banknotes fluttering over a banquet.

name: Fusion Plate
effect: Win 1 cross-region (→X) dish. Flavours that travelled across the island.
art_note: Ticket: a single dish blending two regions' emblems on one plate.

name: Dusk
effect: THE CLOCK — seed at the BOTTOM of the DAY Booking deck. When it is drawn, the day's tours have booked out: finish this turn, then flip the board to night.
art_note: Boarding-pass card — a warm sun handing over to a rising moon over the market

name: Last Train
effect: THE CLOCK — seed at the BOTTOM of the NIGHT Booking deck. When it is drawn, the night's last tours are gone: finish the current round so everyone has had equal turns, then the game ends.
art_note: Boarding-pass card — a lone moon over the last rail as the market lights dim
